# GapsToGrowth HP

GapsToGrowth HP is an AI-powered Education ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) platform designed for educational institutions in India, with a focus on Himachal Pradesh.

## Company Overview

- **Name**: GapsToGrowth HP
- **Type**: Education Technology Company
- **Location**: Himachal Pradesh, India
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Services**: University Management System, School ERP, Corporate Training Solutions

## Target Institutions

GapsToGrowth HP serves three primary segments:

1. **Higher Education**: Universities and colleges requiring accreditation support (NAAC, NIRF), student information systems, and faculty management.
2. **K-12 Schools**: Schools needing student lifecycle management, attendance tracking, parent-teacher communication, and academic reporting.
3. **Corporate Training**: Organizations requiring workforce development, compliance training, and skill management solutions.

## Product Modules

### Talent Solutions
- Talent Management (employee lifecycle)
- Smart Hiring Engine (AI recruitment)
- Skills Validation Studio (certification)
- Skill Management (organizational skills)
- Skill Health Scan (gap analysis)
- Skill Genome Builder (skill mapping)
- Skill Finder (expert location)
- Resource Commander (resource allocation)
- Seamless Onboarding (new hire integration)
- Organization Management (hierarchy)
- Performance Enablement (performance reviews)
- Growth Predictor (career AI insights)
- Competency Matrix (team visualization)
- Career Pathing (succession planning)

### Learning Solutions
- Learning Management System (LMS)
- Mobile Learning (iOS/Android apps)
- Learning Paths (structured journeys)
- Course Library (pre-built content)
- Knowledge Vault (digital repository)
- Build Your Training (custom creation)
- Leadership Shield (executive development)
- Workforce Planning (forecasting)

### Finance & HR
- Payroll Management (automated processing)
- Time & Attendance (biometric integration)
- Leave Management (workflow automation)
- Compliance Management (regulatory tracking)
- Petty Cash & Expense Management

### Integration & Analytics
- System Integration (API connectivity)
- HRIT Solutions (infrastructure support)
- Team Analytics (workforce insights)
- Learning Analytics (training effectiveness)

## Key Use Cases

- Automating university admission and enrollment workflows
- Managing NAAC/NIRF accreditation documentation
- Tracking student and employee attendance via biometric devices
- Delivering corporate training with SCORM-compliant LMS
- Conducting AI-powered recruitment and candidate screening
- Generating real-time analytics dashboards for institutional decision-making

## Differentiators

- **AI-First Approach**: Embedded AI for predictive analytics, personalized learning paths, and automated hiring.
- **Unified Platform**: Single login for all academic and administrative needs.
- **Local Focus**: Solutions tailored for institutions in Himachal Pradesh with regional compliance support.
- **Scalable Architecture**: Cloud-native system that grows with institutional needs.

## Technical Specifications

- **Compliance**: SCORM 1.2/2004 compliant LMS
- **Mobile**: iOS and Android applications available
- **Integration**: REST and SOAP API support
- **Deployment**: Cloud-native, scalable infrastructure
- **Accreditation Support**: NAAC, NIRF documentation and tracking
